candidate.title: `OptimizedCursorPaginator` uses integer-key semantics against a `datetime` column
candidate.description: `get_item_key`/`value_from_cursor` assume numeric keys but endpoint passes `datetime` column. Raises TypeError on cursor build and comparison failures on Postgres. Should subclass `DateTimePaginator` instead.

candidate.title: Negative-offset branch is guaranteed to raise; its comment claims the opposite
candidate.description: Comment incorrectly claims Django ORM handles negative slicing, but it raises ValueError. Negative offsets from user-controlled cursor param create unauthenticated 500 crash path. Should remove unsupported branch.

promotion_candidates.title: `organization_context.member` dereferenced without a None guard — 500s every audit-log request for token auth
promotion_candidates.description: `enable_advanced` computed unconditionally before branch check, causing 500s on every audit-log request for token auth. `RpcUserOrganizationContext.member` is nullable and None for non-org members, raising AttributeError without guard.

promotion_candidates.title: Superuser gate bypasses superuser elevation, and `has_global_access` gates nothing
promotion_candidates.description: Uses raw `is_superuser` flag instead of proper `is_active_superuser` check. `has_global_access` defaults to True and provides no real authorization gate. Creates dangerous bypass pattern.

promotion_candidates.title: Redis key type changed set→zset with no key migration — WRONGTYPE crash-loop across a rolling deploy
promotion_candidates.description: `span-buf:s:` keys switch from set operations to zset operations without migration. During rolling deploy, new pods encounter old schema keys causing WRONGTYPE errors and crash-loops until key expiry. Should bump key prefix or unlink on WRONGTYPE.
